LESSON: VOLLEYBALL

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six
Subject: General
Strand: Creating and Executing
Topic 1.3: Volleyball
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Volleyball, part of Creating and Executing in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade six General.

Key inquiry question: How can service skills in Volleyball be used to win a game?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Volleyball together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner explores multiple perspectives of shading the pictures using appropriate

media.

• Digital literacy: The learner uses digital technology to source virtual or actual pictures of players executing skills in

volleyball.

Values:
• Responsibility: The learner works on art work and clears working area by putting the materials in appropriate places.

• Unity: The learner shares the volleyball equipment as they demonstrate the skills of dig pass and underarm service.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Environmental education - enhanced through sustainable use of locally available materials for making art materials

• Waste management: developed while disposing of the waste after the classroom activity.

Link to other learning areas:

Science and Technology: The learners use skills of measuring and marking

Suggested learning resources

newsprint/packaging papers/sugar paper/brown papers/tracing papers, PE kits, volleyball, volleyball nets, cutting tools,

stitching/pasting resources,pencils/charcoal/chalk/crayon
